message.content: In docs/master-supply-agreement.docx, change the payment terms to net 45 days. Save the redline as a new file.

content.text: Done. Clause 11.1 now reads "forty-five (45) days" instead of "thirty (30) days", as a tracked change by Eval Reviewer (deletion #54, insertion #55). I saved the redline as docs/master-supply-agreement.redline.docx and left docs/master-supply-agreement.docx unchanged.
